subject: art-design
title: Composition: Leading the Eye
welcome_lead: Use lines, framing and viewpoint to guide the viewer.
meta_desc: KS3 composition: leading lines, framing, viewpoint and depth.
final_note: Every choice should pull the eye to what matters.

concepts.def: Lines that guide the eye through the picture.
Using shapes to surround the subject.
Angle the artwork is seen from.

walkthroughs.body_html: A road, river or fence can act as a leading line, walking the viewer's eye into the picture and toward your focal point.
Looking through a window, doorway or branches can frame the subject. This adds depth and focuses attention.
A low viewpoint makes things look powerful. A high view makes them look small. Eye-level feels neutral and natural.

mcqs.q: Which area is nearest the viewer?

numericals.q: How many ground layers (fore/middle/back) make depth?
